name: Universal Arts Limited
about: Universal Arts Limited sells films and TV serials in India. It engages in the business of media, such as editing TV serials; feature films production; and television software, etc.; as well as trades in film rights. The company was formerly known as Goldmines Media Limited and changed its name to Universal Arts Limited in December 2006. Universal Arts Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.
